statements.t: “With strong year-to-date performance and continued momentum in customer bookings, we remain on track to deliver on our full year outlook of approximately 7% Organic Revenue Growth, (or 16% on a reported basis), more than 24% growth in Adjusted EBITDA, and approximately $200 million in operating cash flow,” said Matthijs Glastra, Chair and Chief Executive Officer.
Looking ahead to 2027, we expect reported revenue growth of more than 15%.”
For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects GAAP revenue to be in the range of $306 million to $312 million, reflecting reported revenue growth of more than 18%.
The Company also expects Adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $76 million to $79 million and Adjusted Diluted EPS to be in the range of $0.91 to $0.96 per diluted share, or 0% to 5% growth.
The Company’s guidance assumes no significant changes in foreign exchange rates.
For the full year 2026, the Company now expects GAAP revenue to be in the range of $1,135 million to $1,140 million, reflecting reported growth of approximately 16%.
The company expects Adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $274 million to $277 million, and Adjusted Diluted EPS to be in the range of $3.66 to $3.71 per diluted share, or 11% to 13% growth.

A reconciliation of the Company’s forward-looking Organic Revenue Growth, Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted Diluted EPS, Gross Leverage, and Net Debt Leverage guidance to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures is not provided because of the inherent difficulty in forecasting and quantifying certain amounts that are necessary for such reconciliations, including acquisitions and related expenses; impact of…
A replay of the audio webcast will be available approximately three hours after the conclusion of the call in the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at www.novanta.com .
The Company has also used in the past, and may use in the future, Adjusted Diluted EPS and Adjusted EBITDA as performance targets for certain performance-based restricted stock units.
